import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
t2o=dict(ALA='A',ARG='R',ASN='N',ASP='D',CYS='C',GLN='Q',GLU='E',GLY='G',HIS='H',ILE='I',LEU='L',
 LYS='K',MET='M',PHE='F',PRO='P',SER='S',THR='T',TRP='W',TYR='Y',VAL='V',MSE='M')
def fetch(u):
    r=requests.get(u,headers=H,timeout=120); r.raise_for_status(); return r.text
def parse_all(txt):
    ch={}
    for l in txt.split("\n"):
        if not(l.startswith("ATOM") or l.startswith("HETATM")): continue
        rn=l[17:20].strip()
        if rn not in t2o or l[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
        c=l[21]; key=(int(l[22:26]),l[26]); at=l[12:16].strip()
        d=ch.setdefault(c,{}); d.setdefault(key,dict(aa=t2o[rn],atoms={},b=0.0))
        d[key]['atoms'][at]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
        if at=="CA": d[key]['b']=float(l[60:66])
    return ch

# ---- BLOSUM62 ----
AAo="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
B62raw="""4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
-1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3

0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
M=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in B62raw.strip().split("\n")])
B62={(AAo[i],AAo[j]):M[i,j] for i in range(20) for j in range(20)}
def nw(a,b,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(a),len(b)
    F=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),dtype=int)
    F[0,1:]=go+ge*np.arange(m); F[1:,0]=go+ge*np.arange(n); P[0,1:]=2; P[1:,0]=1
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            d=F[i-1,j-1]+B62.get((a[i-1],b[j-1]),-4)
            u=F[i-1,j]+(ge if P[i-1,j]==1 else go)
            l=F[i,j-1]+(ge if P[i,j-1]==2 else go)
            k=int(np.argmax([d,u,l])); F[i,j]=[d,u,l][k]; P[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; pairs=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i>0 and j>0 and P[i,j]==0: pairs.append((i-1,j-1)); i-=1; j-=1
        elif i>0 and P[i,j]==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return pairs[::-1]
def kabsch(P,Q):
    Pc=P-P.mean(0); Qc=Q-Q.mean(0)
    V,S,Wt=np.linalg.svd(Pc.T@Qc)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt)); D=np.diag([1,1,d])
    R=V@D@Wt
    return float(np.sqrt(((Pc@R-Qc)**2).sum()/len(P)))

# ---- data ----
S4DLQ=parse_all(fetch("https://files.rcsb.org/download/4DLQ.pdb"))
S4DLO=parse_all(fetch("https://files.rcsb.org/download/4DLO.pdb"))
AF=parse_all(fetch("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q96PE1-F1-model_v6.pdb"))['A']
j=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q96PE1.json",headers=H,timeout=90).json()
gain=[(f["location"]["start"]["value"],f["location"]["end"]["value"]) for f in j.get("features",[])
      if f["type"]=="Domain" and "GAIN" in str(f.get("description","")).upper()]
print("ADGRA2 UniProt GAIN domain:",gain)
g0,g1=gain[0]

def chain_seq(ch,lo=None,hi=None):
    ks=[k for k in sorted(ch) if (lo is None or lo<=k[0]<=hi)]
    return "".join(ch[k]['aa'] for k in ks),ks

# ADGRA2 GAIN (AF) vs 4DLQ chain A (ADGRL1 GAIN+HormR) and 4DLO chain A (ADGRB3)
qa,qk=chain_seq(AF,g0,g1)
print(f"ADGRA2 GAIN modelled residues: {len(qk)} ({g0}-{g1})")
res={}
for name,ch in [("4DLQ ADGRL1",S4DLQ['A']),("4DLO ADGRB3",S4DLO['A'])]:
    ta,tk=chain_seq(ch)
    pr=nw(qa,ta)
    P=np.array([AF[qk[i]]['atoms']['CA'] for i,_ in pr if 'CA' in AF[qk[i]]['atoms'] and 'CA' in ch[tk[_]]['atoms']])
    Q=np.array([ch[tk[jj]]['atoms']['CA'] for i,jj in pr if 'CA' in AF[qk[i]]['atoms'] and 'CA' in ch[tk[jj]]['atoms']])
    idt=sum(1 for i,jj in pr if qa[i]==ta[jj])/max(1,len(pr))
    # iterative outlier trimming
    keep=np.ones(len(P),bool)
    for _ in range(8):
        Pk,Qk=P[keep],Q[keep]
        Pc=Pk-Pk.mean(0); Qc=Qk-Qk.mean(0)
        V,Sv,Wt=np.linalg.svd(Pc.T@Qc); d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt)); R=V@np.diag([1,1,d])@Wt
        dev=np.sqrt((((P-Pk.mean(0))@R-(Q-Qk.mean(0)))**2).sum(1))
        new=dev<4.0
        if new.sum()<30 or (new==keep).all(): break
        keep=new
    rms_all=kabsch(P,Q); rms_core=kabsch(P[keep],Q[keep])
    res[name]=(len(pr),idt,len(P),rms_all,int(keep.sum()),rms_core)
    print(f"{name}: aligned pairs {len(pr)}, seq identity {idt*100:.1f}%, CA pairs {len(P)}, "
          f"RMSD(all) {rms_all:.2f} A, core {int(keep.sum())} CA RMSD {rms_core:.2f} A")

# ---- motif comparison ----
POS=list(range(-6,0))+list(range(1,8))
def win(ch,site,chB=None):
    out=[]
    for p in POS:
        n=site+p if p<0 else site+p
        src=ch if p<0 else (chB if chB else ch)
        k=[k for k in src if k[0]==n]
        out.append(src[k[0]]['aa'] if k else '-')
    return out
w_l1=win(S4DLQ['A'],837,S4DLQ['B'])
w_b3=win(S4DLO['A'],856)
w_a2=[AF[[k for k in AF if k[0]==746+p][0]]['aa'] for p in POS]
print("\npos      "," ".join(f"{p:>3}" for p in POS))
for nm,w in [("ADGRL1 rat 4DLQ",w_l1),("ADGRB3 human 4DLO",w_b3),("ADGRA2 human AF",w_a2)]:
    print(f"{nm:<18}"," ".join(f"{a:>3}" for a in w))
